title: Dar Global overview
text: Dar Global is a highly differentiated international real estate business and the international arm of Saudi Arabia's Dar Al Arkan. It develops bespoke luxury homes for internationally mobile customers in the Middle East and Europe, including Jeddah and Riyadh in Saudi Arabia and downtown Dubai. Dar Global was founded in 2017 and is listed on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange (ticker DAR) since 28 February 2023. Dar Al Arkan has been listed on the Saudi Stock Exchange since 2007, has delivered over 15,000 residential units and has total assets of around US$8.5 billion, and is the major shareholder in Dar Global.

title: Dar Global partnerships
text: Dar Global's brand partnerships include Dolce & Gabbana, Elie Saab, Missoni, Versace Home, the Trump Organization, W Hotels, Automobili Pagani and Automobili Lamborghini. Dar Global was originally established to develop the international assets of Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development in Saudi Arabia.

title: Dar Global Dubai projects
text: Dar Global's Dubai projects include Dar Al Arkan Pagani Tower (Da Vinci Tower) near Dubai Canal, Urban Oasis by Missoni, and W Residences in Downtown Dubai. In 2023 CEO Ziad El Chaar said the company planned a pipeline of close to US$2.5 billion of projects over two to three years. Dar Global also partnered with the Trump Organisation on a resort with villas, a hotel and a golf course in Muscat, Oman.

title: Construction starts: Tierra Viva, Aida, Les Vagues
text: Dar Global started construction on three projects: Tierra Viva in Spain (a residential complex of 53 villas inspired by Automobili Lamborghini design), Aida in Oman, and Les Vagues in Qatar.

title: Dar Global 2024 launches
text: In January 2025 Dar Global announced it launched projects with a combined value exceeding US$1.9 billion in 2024 and set its sights on expanding into the United States in 2025.

title: Dar Global in Jeddah
text: Dar Global's existing Jeddah developments include Trump Plaza and Padel Living Residences. The company announced a planned US$267 million mixed-use project in Jeddah, with architectural concept, residential offering and launch date to be announced later. Dar Global also announced Trump Tower Jeddah, which is marketed on Wasalt.sa.

title: DarGlobal partners with Wasalt
text: DarGlobal partnered with Wasalt, one of Saudi Arabia's leading digital real estate platforms, to advertise Trump Tower Jeddah. Wasalt has strong traction in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam, and the Trump Tower Jeddah listing is live on Wasalt.sa and in the Wasalt app on iOS and Android.

title: Wasalt overview
text: Wasalt is Saudi Arabia's AI-powered real estate platform for verified properties and trusted brokers, covering residential and commercial real estate. Users can Buy, Rent, browse Projects and Daily Rentals, list properties for sale or rent, and take part in real estate auctions. Listings are verified by REGA, the General Real Estate Authority. Wasalt has partnered with propgenius.ai for AI features and with the Entrustment and Liquidation Center (Infath) for auctions. Offerings include apartments, villas, houses and plots of land for sale.

title: About Wasalt
text: Wasalt is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan, the leading Saudi real estate developer with more than 27 years of experience, and Quara Holding, a technology startup incubator and innovation hub. It is a website and app specialising in real estate brokerage: searching, buying, renting, real estate marketing and listing for both commercial and residential sectors.

title: Wasalt licences and milestones
text: Wasalt is licensed by REGA as a real estate portal, licensed by Infath as a real estate auction platform, launched Matchmaker packages, and launched Wasalt Business. Wasalt is also a Ministry of Tourism licensed platform for daily rentals (licence number 73106008).

title: Wasalt growth
text: As of January 2025 Wasalt reported more than 750,000 registered users and 100,000 monthly leads, and anticipated a five-fold revenue increase from 2025 to 2028. It offers AI-driven tools such as real-time property valuations and ROI prediction, and a digital auction platform licensed by Infath. Ziad El Chaar is Chairman of Wasalt.
